learning_objective: 🎯 Learn how modern technology and smart devices are used to control lights, fans, and security systems automatically to make homes smarter and save energy!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: A smart home uses technology to connect appliances like lights, fans, and locks to a central system. You can control all these gadgets using a smartphone app or even just your voice!
Sensors are like the digital eyes and ears of a house. Motion sensors detect when someone walks into a room to turn on the lights, and temperature sensors tell the AC when to cool things down.

One of the best vocational benefits of home automation is saving electricity. Smart systems automatically turn off lights and machines when rooms are empty, which helps the environment and lowers bills.
IoT is the magic network that allows everyday objects to talk to each other over the internet. It is what lets a smart speaker tell a smart bulb exactly when to change colors!

fun_activity.title: 🤖 Design Your Smart Bedroom
fun_activity.instructions: Draw a floor plan of your dream bedroom! Mark exactly where you would place smart motion sensors, automated lights, and voice assistants to make it the ultimate high-tech space.

quick_recap: ⭐ Home automation connects daily appliances to the internet so they can be controlled remotely.
⭐ Sensors detect changes in the environment like motion or heat to trigger automatic actions.
⭐ Smart homes are highly energy-efficient because they prevent electricity from being wasted.
